title: Microsoft Teams: personal message reminders for chat and channels
summary: The briefing agrees with Microsoft's roadmap and tenant notice on rollout, default availability and user behaviour. Its statements about undocumented reminder controls, pricing and compliance details were confirmed by targeted searches; no correction is required.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and api; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no tenant or policy switch for personal message reminders on either the admin UI or automation surface.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "message reminders" admin policy disable Microsoft Graph PowerShell. Read MC1470887 and Manage messaging policies in Teams; searched the full Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy reference for remind, finding none. No reminder switch or endpoint found.

claims.claim: Teams messaging policies exist.
claims.quote: Messaging policies are used to control which chat and channel messaging features are available to users (owners and members) in Microsoft Teams.

claims.claim: The Teams messaging policies documentation lists no personal reminders setting.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "message reminders" admin policy disable Microsoft Graph PowerShell. Read every messaging policy setting at learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/messaging-policies-in-teams; searched Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy for remind. Neither lists reminders.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: MC1470887 does not say how reminder data is retained.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "message reminders" retention eDiscovery source message deleted. Read the complete supplied MC1470887 and Manage retention policies for Microsoft Teams; the notice discusses storage but gives no reminder retention period or mechanism.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: MC1470887 does not say how reminder data is searched with eDiscovery.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "message reminders" retention eDiscovery source message deleted. Read the complete MC1470887; its compliance answers cover storage, message access and user management, but not searches or eDiscovery.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented how Teams retention policies cover the separately stored reminder data.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "message reminders" retention eDiscovery source message deleted. Read Manage retention policies for Microsoft Teams and Learn about retention for Microsoft Teams excerpts; they cover chat/channel messages, not separately stored personal reminders.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether eDiscovery searches cover the separately stored reminder data.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "personal reminders" licensing price notification retention eDiscovery; "Teams" "message reminders" retention eDiscovery source message deleted. Read Teams security/compliance excerpts and Content search guidance; no reminder-data coverage found.

claims.claim: No change to sign-in is described in the roadmap record or notice.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Teams" "message reminders". Read the full roadmap description and MC1470887, including compliance answers; neither describes sign-in changes.

claims.claim: No change to permissions is described in the roadmap record or notice.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Teams" "message reminders". Read the full roadmap description and MC1470887; the notice describes another way to access message content but no permission changes.

claims.claim: The sources describe user-managed reminders, not autonomous actions beyond the documented due-time notifications.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Teams" "message reminders". Read roadmap description and MC1470887: users create, update, complete and delete reminders; the automatic behaviour described is due-time notifications and badges, not independent actions on message content.

claims.claim: The notice names no prerequisites.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Teams" "message reminders". Read MC1470887 in full, including platforms, impact, recommendations and compliance considerations; it names no prerequisite and says no admin configuration is required.

claims.claim: The notice does not specify which existing Teams notification settings reminders respect.
claims.quote: Searched: "Teams" "reminders" "notification settings" "muted". Read full MC1470887: it says existing Teams notification settings, naming none. Results describe general mobile settings or other reminder features, not this feature's setting mapping.
